newsitem.title: USA: Dow surges, one-day record gain in reach.
newsitem.headline: Dow surges, one-day record gain in reach.

text.p: U.S. blue chips surged to session highs in late trading on Tuesday and the Dow industrials closed in on their one-day record gain.

At its peak, the Dow touched just shy of 6971, for a gain of 187 points on the session. If held, the rally would eclipse the blue chip average's current record rise of 186.84 points, set on October 21, 1987.
Shortly after reaching its intraday peak, the Dow edged back to 6962, up 179 points, which would stand as second best ever, topping a 173 point gain tallied just last Tuesday.
Bonds continued to soar. The benchmark 30-year U.S. Treasury jumped 1-18/32 to yield 6.98 percent.
